title: Network Load Balancing with In-network Reordering Support for RDMA
authors: Cha Hwan Song; Xin Zhe Khooi; Raj Joshi; Inho Choi; Jialin Li; Mun Choon Chan
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication

problem_statement.en: RDMA traffic is highly sensitive to out-of-order packet arrivals, which trigger unnecessary loss recovery and rate reduction, while existing load balancing algorithms fail to effectively distribute RDMA traffic due to its continuous flow characteristics and lack of sufficient flowlet gaps.
problem_statement.zh: RDMA 流量對亂序封包到達高度敏感，容易觸發不必要的丟失恢復與速率降低；而現有負載均衡演算法因 RDMA 流量的連續流特性及 flowlet 間隔不足，難以有效分配 RDMA 流量。

key_innovation.en: ConWeave, a load balancing framework that performs fine-grained rerouting and masks out-of-order packet arrivals by using programmable switches to reorder packets in the network datapath.
key_innovation.zh: ConWeave 是一個負載均衡框架，透過可程式化交換機在網路資料路徑中對封包重排序，執行細粒度重路由並屏蔽亂序封包到達。

key_improvements.en: Up to 42.3% improvement in average FCT and 66.8% improvement in 99-percentile FCT compared to state-of-the-art algorithms.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最先進演算法，平均 FCT 改善最高 42.3%，99 百分位 FCT 改善最高 66.8%。

workload_and_traffic.ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Model Training, Distributed Deep Learning (DDL)
workload_and_traffic.traffic_pattern: RDMA WRITE, Elephant flows, Concurrent flows
